purpose: Reserve layout space while content loads.
avoid: Do not imply meaningful content or hide an indefinite failure.
basis: Native source page 73:1989 (Skeleton), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: The host supplies Loading contacts as the meaningful status; the source skeleton geometry is explicitly hidden in this reference.
updatesAndDescendants: Skeleton itself is a div with animate-pulse and inherited props. The caller owns loading/data/error and aria-busy, replaces visual loading shapes with content after completion, and reports failure instead of pulsing forever. Reduced motion stops loading animation without removing status text.
referenceDecision: The labelled busy region, status text, aria-hidden and motion policy are authorized reference composition decisions, not built-in behavior claimed for the bare Skeleton wrapper.
